chk_agent_operation_events_actor.name: chk_agent_operation_events_actor
chk_agent_operation_events_actor.value: NOT ("api"."agent_operation_events"."actor_user_id" IS NULL AND "api"."agent_operation_events"."actor_credential_id" IS NULL)

chk_agent_operation_policies_target_id.name: chk_agent_operation_policies_target_id
chk_agent_operation_policies_target_id.value: ("api"."agent_operation_policies"."target_type" = 'workspace' AND "api"."agent_operation_policies"."target_id" IS NULL) OR ("api"."agent_operation_policies"."target_type" <> 'workspace' AND "api"."agent_operation_policies"."target_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_agent_operation_policies_limits.name: chk_agent_operation_policies_limits
chk_agent_operation_policies_limits.value: jsonb_typeof("api"."agent_operation_policies"."limits") = 'object' AND ("api"."agent_operation_policies"."limits"->>'maxAffectedRows' IS NULL OR (("api"."agent_operation_policies"."limits"->>'maxAffectedRows')::integer BETWEEN 1 AND 1000))

chk_agent_operation_proposals_approval_a.name: chk_agent_operation_proposals_approval_actor
chk_agent_operation_proposals_approval_a.value: "api"."agent_operation_proposals"."approval_policy" <> 'human_required' OR "api"."agent_operation_proposals"."status" NOT IN ('approved','executing','succeeded','failed') OR ("api"."agent_operation_proposals"."approved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "api"."agent_operation_proposals"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

chk_agent_operation_proposals_execution_.name: chk_agent_operation_proposals_execution_actor
chk_agent_operation_proposals_execution_.value: "api"."agent_operation_proposals"."status" NOT IN ('executing','succeeded','failed') OR (("api"."agent_operation_proposals"."executed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("api"."agent_operation_proposals"."executed_by_credential_id" IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

chk_agent_workflow_events_actor.name: chk_agent_workflow_events_actor
chk_agent_workflow_events_actor.value: NOT ("api"."agent_workflow_events"."actor_user_id" IS NULL AND "api"."agent_workflow_events"."actor_credential_id" IS NULL)

chk_calendar_booking_participants_identi.name: chk_calendar_booking_participants_identity
chk_calendar_booking_participants_identi.value: "api"."calendar_booking_participants"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "api"."calendar_booking_participants"."display_name" IS NOT NULL

uq_connector_runs_digest.name: uq_connector_runs_digest
uq_connector_runs_digest.where: request_digest IS NOT NULL AND status = 'succeeded'

uq_connector_runs_selector_running.name: uq_connector_runs_selector_running
uq_connector_runs_selector_running.where: selector_digest IS NOT NULL AND status = 'running'

chk_connector_runs_selector.name: chk_connector_runs_selector
chk_connector_runs_selector.value: selector_digest IS NULL OR length(btrim(selector_digest)) BETWEEN 16 AND 128

chk_dataset_bulk_commits_actor_xor.name: chk_dataset_bulk_commits_actor_xor
chk_dataset_bulk_commits_actor_xor.value: (("api"."dataset_bulk_commits"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("api"."dataset_bulk_commits"."actor_credential_id" IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

chk_datasets_created_by_actor.name: chk_datasets_created_by_actor
chk_datasets_created_by_actor.value: NOT ("api"."datasets"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "api"."datasets"."created_by_credential_id" IS NOT NULL)

uq_pipeline_runs_digest.name: uq_pipeline_runs_digest
uq_pipeline_runs_digest.where: input_digest IS NOT NULL AND trigger_occurrence_id IS NULL AND status = 'succeeded'

uq_pipeline_runs_digest_running.name: uq_pipeline_runs_digest_running
uq_pipeline_runs_digest_running.where: input_digest IS NOT NULL AND trigger_occurrence_id IS NULL AND status = 'running'

uq_pipeline_runs_occurrence_running.name: uq_pipeline_runs_occurrence_running
uq_pipeline_runs_occurrence_running.where: trigger_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'running'

uq_pipeline_runs_occurrence_succeeded.name: uq_pipeline_runs_occurrence_succeeded
uq_pipeline_runs_occurrence_succeeded.where: trigger_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'succeeded'

chk_pipeline_runs_occurrence.name: chk_pipeline_runs_occurrence
chk_pipeline_runs_occurrence.value: "api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_occurrence_id" IS NULL OR (length("api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_occurrence_id") BETWEEN 8 AND 128 AND "api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_occurrence_id" ~ '^[a-z]+:[A-Za-z0-9:_+-]+$')

chk_pipeline_runs_occurrence_trigger.name: chk_pipeline_runs_occurrence_trigger
chk_pipeline_runs_occurrence_trigger.value: ("api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_kind" = 'manual' AND ("api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_occurrence_id" IS NULL OR "api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_occurrence_id" LIKE 'manual:%')) OR ("api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_kind" <> 'manual' AND "api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_occurrence_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_pipeline_runs_schedule.name: chk_pipeline_runs_schedule
chk_pipeline_runs_schedule.value: ("api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_kind" = 'manual' AND "api"."pipeline_runs"."schedule_id" IS NULL) OR ("api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_kind" = 'event' AND "api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_occurrence_id" LIKE 'webhook:%' AND "api"."pipeline_runs"."schedule_id" IS NULL) OR ("api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_kind" IN ('scheduled', 'event') AND "api"."pipeline_runs"."trigger_occurrence_id" IS NOT NULL AND "api"."pipeline_runs"."schedule_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_reagent_movements_quantity_delta.name: chk_reagent_movements_quantity_delta
chk_reagent_movements_quantity_delta.value: ("api"."reagent_movements"."operation" = 'receive' AND "api"."reagent_movements"."quantity_delta" > 0) OR ("api"."reagent_movements"."operation" = 'consume' AND "api"."reagent_movements"."quantity_delta" < 0) OR ("api"."reagent_movements"."operation" IN ('quarantine','restore') AND "api"."reagent_movements"."quantity_delta" = 0)

chk_records_updated_by_actor.name: chk_records_updated_by_actor
chk_records_updated_by_actor.value: NOT ("api"."records"."updated_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "api"."records"."updated_by_credential_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_review_decisions_note.name: chk_review_decisions_note
chk_review_decisions_note.value: "api"."review_decisions"."note" IS NULL OR length("api"."review_decisions"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 8000

chk_sample_events_quantity_presence.name: chk_sample_events_quantity_presence
chk_sample_events_quantity_presence.value: ("api"."sample_events"."quantity_delta" IS NOT NULL) = ("api"."sample_events"."quantity_before" IS NOT NULL) AND ("api"."sample_events"."quantity_delta" IS NOT NULL) = ("api"."sample_events"."quantity_after" IS NOT NULL)

chk_sample_events_transfer_locations.name: chk_sample_events_transfer_locations
chk_sample_events_transfer_locations.value: "api"."sample_events"."operation" <> 'transfer' OR ("api"."sample_events"."from_location" IS NOT NULL AND "api"."sample_events"."to_location" IS NOT NULL AND "api"."sample_events"."from_location" <> "api"."sample_events"."to_location")

chk_sheet_instance_local_mutations_actor.name: chk_sheet_instance_local_mutations_actor_xor
chk_sheet_instance_local_mutations_actor.value: (("api"."sheet_instance_local_mutations"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("api"."sheet_instance_local_mutations"."actor_credential_id" IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

chk_sheet_instances_created_by_actor.name: chk_sheet_instances_created_by_actor
chk_sheet_instances_created_by_actor.value: NOT ("api"."sheet_instances"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "api"."sheet_instances"."created_by_credential_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_sheet_instances_updated_by_actor.name: chk_sheet_instances_updated_by_actor
chk_sheet_instances_updated_by_actor.value: NOT ("api"."sheet_instances"."updated_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "api"."sheet_instances"."updated_by_credential_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_storage_movements_positions.name: chk_storage_movements_positions
chk_storage_movements_positions.value: "api"."storage_movements"."from_position_id" IS NOT NULL OR "api"."storage_movements"."to_position_id" IS NOT NULL

chk_storage_rooms_temp_range.name: chk_storage_rooms_temp_range
chk_storage_rooms_temp_range.value: "api"."storage_rooms"."temperature_min_c" IS NULL OR "api"."storage_rooms"."temperature_max_c" IS NULL OR "api"."storage_rooms"."temperature_min_c" <= "api"."storage_rooms"."temperature_max_c"

chk_storage_sites_temp_range.name: chk_storage_sites_temp_range
chk_storage_sites_temp_range.value: "api"."storage_sites"."temperature_min_c" IS NULL OR "api"."storage_sites"."temperature_max_c" IS NULL OR "api"."storage_sites"."temperature_min_c" <= "api"."storage_sites"."temperature_max_c"

chk_storage_units_temp_range.name: chk_storage_units_temp_range
chk_storage_units_temp_range.value: "api"."storage_units"."temperature_min_c" IS NULL OR "api"."storage_units"."temperature_max_c" IS NULL OR "api"."storage_units"."temperature_min_c" <= "api"."storage_units"."temperature_max_c"

chk_studies_date_range.name: chk_studies_date_range
chk_studies_date_range.value: "api"."studies"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "api"."studies"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "api"."studies"."ends_on" >= "api"."studies"."starts_on"

chk_study_task_assignments_identity.name: chk_study_task_assignments_identity
chk_study_task_assignments_identity.value: "api"."study_task_assignments"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "api"."study_task_assignments"."display_name" IS NOT NULL

chk_webhook_subscriptions_actor_xor.name: chk_webhook_subscriptions_actor_xor
chk_webhook_subscriptions_actor_xor.value:
("api"."webhook_subscriptions"."created_by_user_id" IS NULL) <> ("api"."webhook_subscriptions"."created_by_credential_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("api"."webhook_subscriptions"."created_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "api"."webhook_subscriptions"."created_by_credential_id" IS NULL)
